item.title: RCSO reports crews working grass fire south of County Road 418
item.description: The Randall County Sheriff's Office reported that crews are working two grass fires south of County Road 418 Monday afternoon.

item.title: Amarillo gas prices up 1.3 cents, average $2.45/gallon on Monday
item.description: Gas prices in the Amarillo area rose 1.3 cents per gallon in the last week, reaching an average of $2.45/gallon on Monday, according to the most recent report from GasBuddy. Those prices were noted as 15.7 cents higher than a month ago and 12.3 cents lower than one year ago.

item.title: With Selection Sunday nearing, women's selection committee tabs Texas a No. 1 seed
item.description: After being left out of the top four seeds in the first draft of the top 16 seeds, the Longhorns are now back in as the No. 1 seed in the second Sacramento regional, the committee announced March 1.

item.title: Six Texas Congressional races to watch for on Tuesday
item.description: In the upcoming March primary, all 38 of Texas's Congressional seats are up for grabs, with many districts having 'non-traditional' races to watch, including two Democratic incumbents facing each other in TX-18 and a controversial Republican incumbent in TX-23

item.title: Trump awards Medal of Honor to 3 Army service members at White House
item.description: President Donald Trump recognized three U.S. Army soldiers with the Medal of Honor at the White House on Monday, with two of the commendations being awarded posthumously.

item.title: 'Indicators' of possible terrorism in deadly Austin mass shooting: FBI
item.description: Two people are dead and 14 more are injured after the early morning shooting. The alleged gunman was fatally shot by officers, according to authorities.
